```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
edges    <- load_edges()
members  <- load_members()
units    <- load_units()
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# one chip per domain, linking to the filtered list below
counts <- statutes |>
  dplyr::count(domain, domain_name, domain_label) |>
  dplyr::arrange(match(domain, names(domain_labels)))

chips <- paste0(
  "<button type=\"button\" class=\"domain-chip domain-", counts$domain,
  "\" data-category=\"", counts$domain_name, "\" title=\"", counts$domain_label, "\">",
  "<span class=\"chip-count\">", counts$n, "</span> ", counts$domain_label, "</button>"
)

cat("<div class=\"domain-chips\">", chips,
    "<button type=\"button\" class=\"domain-chip chip-clear\" data-category=\"\">Show all</button>",
    "</div>", sep = "\n")
cat(
  "\n", nrow(statutes), " statutes, ", nrow(edges), " recorded connections, ",
  length(units), " [study units](study/index.qmd), and ", length(members), " [member lenses](members/index.qmd). ",
  "Every statute page links to its official text on GovInfo; the [Sources](sources.qmd) page lists everything the wiki draws on.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

::: {.start-here}
**New here?** The [study guide](study/index.qmd) explains how these laws fit together, from the Constitution down to single code sections, and walks through them in eleven units. The [knowledge graph](graph.qmd) shows the same connections visually.
:::

## All statutes

Type in the filter box to search titles and citations, click a column to sort, or pick a category on the right to narrow by domain, status, layer, or U.S. Code title. The search icon in the top bar searches the full text of every page. Links to repealed and superseded laws are marked with a dagger (†).

<label class="inline-toggle"><input type="checkbox" data-wiki-toggle> Show current law only (hide repealed and superseded). The same switch is in the top bar and applies across the site.</label>

::: {#statute-list}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
// a domain chip clicks the matching entry in the Categories list; "Show all" clicks All
document.querySelectorAll(".domain-chip").forEach(function (chip) {
  chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var wanted = chip.dataset.category;
    document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category .category").forEach(function (el) {
      // category text reads like "War powers (19)"
      var name = el.textContent.trim().replace(/\s*\(\d+\)$/, "");
      if (wanted === "" ? name === "All" : name === wanted) {
        el.click();
      }
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".domain-chip").forEach(function (c) { c.classList.toggle("active", c === chip && wanted !== ""); });
    document.getElementById("all-statutes").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  });
});
</script>
```
